content:
Alex: PTAL on PR #8425 — I addressed the comments, split the helper into helpers/io.go, added a small smoke script, and left a note about a tiny p99 regression in the PR description. Hoping to merge before EOD if no objections.
Jordan: taking a look now. which test inputs showed the p99 shift?
Alex: long-seq compaction path. I added a conservative fallback in kernel selection which seems to trade ~2% p99 in a specific synthetic. See the comment with repro and perf plot: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-infra/pull/8425#discussion_r1234567
Priya: PTAL too — can we gate the canary behind a feature flag so we can roll back quickly if needed? I can run the canary tonight.
Sam: quick nit: add a changelog line and ping infra for canary window. otherwise looks fine to me. :thumbsup:
Casey: ran the smoke locally, tests passed. Left one inline about handling a missing KV cache key (edge case).
Alex: good catch Casey — fixed and pushed (squash). Smoke script is at `scripts/smoke/pr_8425.sh`. Example: ```./scripts/smoke/pr_8425.sh --scale=10 --runs=3```
Priya: thanks — I can schedule canary at 20:00 PT behind the flag. Jordan, can you confirm that the fallback is safe for production traffic?
Jordan: looked through the fallback change. It only changes kernel selection for sequences > 2k and preserves correctness; added 2 logging lines only. safe to canary. approving now.
Alex: thanks Jordan! I'll hold merge until canary completes; if green I'll merge and deploy.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2026-03-17T20:00:00-07:00 (20:00 PT) for PR #8425 — feature flag: `kernel-fallback-guard`.
Sam: noted — pinging infra for the window.
Priya: will report back after the canary runs.
Alex: awesome, thanks everyone. If anything pops up please @alex and I’ll revert immediately.
